# SetManifest

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Output` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public record SetManifest
```

The Set's own record, written to `set.json`: its name, size, seed, the hash of the book that produced it, the collection-wide rarity table and the per-recipe distribution. Reports such as [`SetReport`](Nfty.Core.Stats.SetReport.md) read it alone, so inspecting a large Set costs the same as inspecting a small one.

### SetManifest(string, int, string, string?, string, IReadOnlyList&lt;RecipeCount&gt;, IReadOnlyList&lt;RarityAttribute&gt;, bool?, SetModels?) { #m-ctor-system-string-system-int32-system-string-system-s-3bb89f }

```csharp
public SetManifest(string Name, int Count, string Seed, string? CookbookSha256, string GeneratorVersion, IReadOnlyList<RecipeCount> Distribution, IReadOnlyList<RarityAttribute> Rarity, bool? UniqueDna = null, SetModels? Models = null);
```

**Parameters**

- `Name` (`string`) - The collection's name.
- `Count` (`int`) - How many assets the Set holds.
- `Seed` (`string`) - The seed that produced it; the same seed and cookbook reproduce it exactly.
- `CookbookSha256` (`string?`) - SHA-256 of the source `.cbk` — what ties a Set back to the exact archive that produced it. Null when the cookbook never came from a file (an in-memory book). Documented here rather than on the parameter itself: a `<summary>` inside a positional record's parameter list is not a valid documentation location, so the compiler discarded it with CS1587 and no tooling ever saw it — on the one field CLAUDE.md insists stays threaded through.
- `GeneratorVersion` (`string`) - The engine version stamp.
- `Distribution` (`IReadOnlyList<RecipeCount>`) - Per-recipe counts and shares across the Set.
- `Rarity` (`IReadOnlyList<RarityAttribute>`) - The collection-wide rarity table.
- `UniqueDna` (`bool?`) - Whether every asset was required to have distinct DNA. Recorded because the seed does NOT reproduce a run on its own. The same cookbook and the same seed generate a different collection depending on this switch — with uniqueness on, a colliding roll is discarded and re-rolled, which consumes RNG draws that the unlimited run never spends, so the two diverge from the first collision onward. Without this field a Set carried two thirds of its own recipe. **Null means "not recorded"**, not "false": Sets written before this field existed cannot say, and claiming they were unique would be inventing a fact. Additive and optional, so `Schema.Current` is deliberately NOT bumped — older builds ignore unknown properties, whereas a bump would make them reject the file outright.
- `Models` (`SetModels?`) - The 3D models the cook made, or null (and absent from the file) when it made none. Additive and optional, no schema bump.

Whether every asset was required to have distinct DNA.

Recorded because the seed does NOT reproduce a run on its own. The same cookbook and the same seed generate a different collection depending on this switch — with uniqueness on, a colliding roll is discarded and re-rolled, which consumes RNG draws that the unlimited run never spends, so the two diverge from the first collision onward. Without this field a Set carried two thirds of its own recipe.

**Null means "not recorded"**, not "false": Sets written before this field existed cannot say, and claiming they were unique would be inventing a fact. Additive and optional, so `Schema.Current` is deliberately NOT bumped — older builds ignore unknown properties, whereas a bump would make them reject the file outright.
